eventDetail.scope: The 2nd International Conference on Communication, Computing and Signal Processing (ICCCS - 2026) encompasses a broad multidisciplinary spectrum focused on the integration of next-generation digital technologies and intelligent systems. Its scope primarily covers Advanced Communication Systems, including 6G networks, IoT infrastructure, and network security; Intelligent Computing, spanning artificial intelligence, big data analytics, and quantum algorithms; and Signal and Image Processing, which addresses computer vision, biometrics, and audio analysis. By bridging these fields, the conference facilitates the exploration of cross-disciplinary applications such as smart city development, autonomous robotics, and sustainable healthcare technology, providing a global forum for researchers to present innovations that drive the evolution of modern electronic and computational ecosystems.
